title: Presence ts and age_s accept integers above uint64
description:
Spec 18.5.1 marks ts as uint. _require_ts and _require_age_s only require type int and value >= 0. apply_automatic_status and PUT fill ts with int(now_f) with no upper bound.

Python then encodes values >= 2**64 as CBOR bignums (tag 2). _decode_single_cbor rejects tags, so those documents cannot PUT. Rust lichen-client Presence.ts / age_s are u64. Other Python codecs cap uints at (1 << 64) - 1 (messaging ids, RPL sequence, announce revision).

File: python/src/lichen/presence.py _require_ts, _require_age_s, apply_automatic_status ts=int(now_f)
acceptance_criteria: ts and age_s must be integers in 0..2**64-1. Larger values raise PresenceError. PUT of a too-large ts is 4.00. Vector timestamps still decode.
